_comment_: Wave 12 Phase 3 (2026-05-18): pre-xUnit-v3 the test suite ran with class-level parallelism by default; v3 enables finer-grained collection parallelism that breaks tests sharing %ProgramData%\VPNRouter\config.yaml (SettingsLoaderRobustnessTests, MainWindowViewModelAppsModeTests, etc.). Disabling parallelization keeps the harness behavior aligned with the pre-bump suite — same as our headless tests already needed sequential dispatcher-thread access.
